holds.reason: Salt occupation is the root’s explicit interpretation, but the primary comparison does not state it. Penei Moshe instead explains Malacha as from Malchaya and sardavvateh as thin meat soaked to appear fat. Preserve the competing attributed explanations.

notes.text: The two actual primary passages locate the Malcha figure and sukkah instruction. Consequential lexical/occupation hold: the root says salt, while Penei Moshe reads a place-name and describes cosmetic preparation of meat. Existing English faithfully translates the root, so retain it and expose this conflicting commentary separately rather than substitute the commentator’s view into Heilprin.
